episode_summary: This episode explores the impact of global events on mortgage rates and highlights specialty loan programs for professionals like doctors and veterans. Austin Clarence provides insights into navigating the current housing market, emphasizing the importance of focusing on payment affordability over interest rates. The discussion also covers opportunities for self-employed individuals to secure loans without traditional tax documentation.
